description: This file implements a manager for cgroup v2 unified hierarchy, providing functions to create, configure, retrieve stats, and manage processes within cgroups, specifically for Linux kernel cgroup v2.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: A struct managing cgroup v2 hierarchy, including configuration, controllers, and directory path.

methods.name: NewManager
methods.description: Creates a new Manager instance for cgroup v2 hierarchy, initializing directory path.

methods.name: getControllers
methods.description: Reads and caches the list of controllers from cgroup.controllers file.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the cgroup configuration to a process with specified pid.

methods.name: AddPid
methods.description: Adds a process pid to a specified subcgroup.

methods.name: GetPids
methods.description: Retrieves pids associated with the cgroup.

methods.name: GetAllPids
methods.description: Retrieves all pids in the cgroup hierarchy.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Gathers various statistics from the cgroup, including memory, cpu, io, and pressure metrics.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Sets the freezer state of the cgroup.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the cgroup.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Configures the cgroup resources and settings.

methods.name: setUnified
methods.description: Sets unified (cgroup v2) resources via writing to files.

methods.name: GetPaths
methods.description: Returns a map with the cgroup path.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the cgroup path exists.

methods.name: OOMKillCount
methods.description: Returns the count of OOM kills from memory.events.

methods.name: CheckMemoryUsage
methods.description: Checks if current memory usage exceeds specified limits.
